title: Total random example budget
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, and a rational failure parameter $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, the total random example budget is the number of calls in the size-$k$ junta tree multiplied by the per-node random example bound for dimension $n$, size parameter $k$, and the per-call failure parameter assigned from $k$ and $\delta$.
